```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(season >= first_season, season <= last_season) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
team_season <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(classification == "fbs", season <= last_season) |>
  collect()
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
team_colors <- team_color_values(teams)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
tier_rates <- draft_rates(group_by(credited, tier_label))
tr <- function(t, col) tier_rates[[col]][tier_rates$tier_label == t]
power_g5_udfa <- tr("Power", "udfa_rate") / tr("Group of 5", "udfa_rate")
fbs_cr <- credited |>
  filter(tier_label != "FCS and below") |>
  mutate(
    league = case_when(
      conference == "FBS Independents" & team == "Notre Dame" ~ "Notre Dame",
      conference == "FBS Independents" ~ "Other FBS independents",
      .default = conference
    )
  )
league_tier <- fbs_cr |>
  count(league, tier_label, wt = n_eligible) |>
  group_by(league) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(league, tier = tier_label)
conf_rates <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_cr, league)) |>
  left_join(league_tier, by = "league") |>
  arrange(draft_rate)
# Each school's last FBS conference.
conf_now <- team_season |>
  group_by(team) |>
  slice_max(season, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    team,
    conf_now = if_else(
      conference == "FBS Independents",
      "FBS independents",
      conference
    )
  )
school_tier <- fbs_cr |>
  count(team, tier_label, wt = n_eligible) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(team, school_tier = tier_label)
school_rates <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_cr, team)) |>
  left_join(school_tier, by = "team") |>
  left_join(conf_now, by = "team")
n_power_schools <- sum(school_rates$school_tier == "Power")
udfa_heavy <- school_rates |>
  filter(school_tier == "Power", udfa > drafted) |>
  arrange(desc(udfa - drafted), team)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
dumb <- conf_rates |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(draft_rate, udfa_rate),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    outcome = if_else(
      outcome == "draft_rate",
      "Drafted",
      "Undrafted free agent"
    ),
    league = factor(league, levels = conf_rates$league)
  )
p <- ggplot(dumb, aes(rate, league)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = league), color = "grey75", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      color = outcome,
      tooltip = paste0(
        league,
        ": ",
        pct(rate),
        " of ",
        fmt(eligible),
        " eligible players ",
        tolower(outcome)
      ),
      data_id = paste(league, outcome)
    ),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Drafted" = "#374151", "Undrafted free agent" = "#9ca3af"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Draft and undrafted rates by conference",
    subtitle = "Eligible players drafted (dark grey) and signed undrafted (mid grey)",
    x = "Share of eligible players",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(
  p,
  "undrafted-signings-by-conference",
  release = release,
  height = 8
)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
bind_rows(
  tier_rates |>
    filter(tier_label != "FCS and below") |>
    transmute(
      Group = paste("All", tier_label),
      eligible,
      drafted,
      udfa,
      draft_rate,
      udfa_rate
    ),
  conf_rates |>
    transmute(Group = league, eligible, drafted, udfa, draft_rate, udfa_rate)
) |>
  transmute(
    Group,
    Eligible = fmt(eligible),
    Drafted = fmt(drafted),
    `Draft rate` = pct(draft_rate),
    `Undrafted free agents` = fmt(udfa),
    `Undrafted rate` = pct(udfa_rate)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Group",
      "Eligible players",
      "Drafted",
      "Draft rate",
      "Undrafted free agents",
      "Undrafted rate"
    ),
    caption = sprintf(
      "Draft and undrafted rates by FBS tier and conference, final seasons %s to %s. Power players were drafted at %.1f times the Group of 5 rate but signed undrafted at %.1f times it.",
      first_season,
      last_season,
      tr("Power", "draft_rate") / tr("Group of 5", "draft_rate"),
      power_g5_udfa
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: schools-by-position
# One row per school and position group; groups without a recorded position
# have no colour and drop out.
# School position groups with few eligible players swing on one or two
# signings, so they drop out of every figure split by position.
min_eligible <- 10L
school_pos_all <- fbs_cr |>
  filter(position_group %in% position_group_levels()) |>
  group_by(team, position_group) |>
  draft_rates() |>
  left_join(conf_now, by = "team") |>
  mutate(
    position_group = factor(position_group, levels = position_group_levels())
  )
school_pos <- filter(school_pos_all, eligible >= min_eligible)
n_small <- nrow(filter(school_pos_all, eligible > 0)) - nrow(school_pos)
p_school_pos <- ggplot(school_pos, aes(draft_rate, udfa_rate)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#6b7280"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = team,
      size = eligible,
      tooltip = paste0(
        team,
        " (",
        conf_now,
        "), ",
        tolower(position_group),
        "\n",
        drafted,
        " drafted, ",
        udfa,
        " undrafted free agents, of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible"
      ),
      data_id = team
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~position_group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = highlight_colors(team_colors),
    na.value = "#6b7280",
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft rate",
    y = "Undrafted rate",
    title = "Every FBS school's draft and undrafted rates, by position group",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "One dot per school in each group; on the dashed line, as many drafted as signed undrafted\n%s school position groups with fewer than %s eligible players left out; hover a dot to find its school in every group",
      fmt(n_small),
      min_eligible
    ),
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.8)))
card_interactive(p_school_pos, height_svg = 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: position-gaps
# A school's gap in a position group is one rate minus the other, in
# percentage points.
gaps <- school_pos |>
  mutate(
    entered = drafted + udfa,
    udfa_gap = 100 * (udfa_rate - draft_rate),
    entry_gap = 100 * (1 - 2 * entered / eligible),
    position_group = forcats::fct_rev(position_group)
  )
gap_swarm <- function(
  d,
  gap,
  side,
  side_colors,
  title,
  reading,
  x_label,
  tooltip
) {
  ggplot(d, aes({{ gap }}, position_group)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#6b7280") +
    geom_point_interactive(
      aes(color = {{ side }}, tooltip = {{ tooltip }}, data_id = team),
      position = ggbeeswarm::position_quasirandom(
        orientation = "y",
        width = 0.4
      ),
      size = 2.2,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = side_colors,
      breaks = names(side_colors),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Each dot is an FBS school in one position group, final seasons %s to %s; %s\n%s school position groups with fewer than %s eligible players left out; hover a dot to find its school in every group",
        first_season,
        last_season,
        reading,
        fmt(n_small),
        min_eligible
      ),
      x = x_label,
      y = NULL,
      caption = card_caption(release)
    ) +
    theme_cfb2nfl() +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.8)))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: udfa-gap
p_udfa_gap <- gaps |>
  mutate(
    side = case_when(
      udfa > drafted ~ "More signed undrafted",
      drafted > udfa ~ "More drafted",
      .default = "As many of each"
    )
  ) |>
  gap_swarm(
    udfa_gap,
    side,
    c(
      "More drafted" = "#1B9E77",
      "More signed undrafted" = "#7570B3",
      "As many of each" = "#374151"
    ),
    "Undrafted rate minus draft rate, by school and position group",
    "right of zero, more signed undrafted than drafted",
    "Undrafted rate minus draft rate (percentage points)",
    paste0(
      team,
      ", ",
      tolower(position_group),
      "\n",
      drafted,
      " drafted, ",
      udfa,
      " undrafted free agents, of ",
      eligible,
      " eligible"
    )
  )
card_interactive(p_udfa_gap, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: entry-gap
p_entry_gap <- gaps |>
  mutate(
    side = if_else(
      2 * entered > eligible,
      "Most eligible players entered the NFL",
      "Most did not"
    )
  ) |>
  gap_swarm(
    entry_gap,
    side,
    c(
      "Most eligible players entered the NFL" = "#374151",
      "Most did not" = "#D1D5DB"
    ),
    "Rate not entering the NFL minus rate entering, by school and position group",
    "left of zero, most eligible players entered the NFL",
    "Rate not entering the NFL minus rate entering (percentage points)",
    paste0(
      team,
      ", ",
      tolower(position_group),
      "\n",
      entered,
      " entered the NFL (",
      drafted,
      " drafted, ",
      udfa,
      " undrafted), ",
      eligible - entered,
      " did not, of ",
      eligible,
      " eligible"
    )
  )
card_interactive(p_entry_gap, height_svg = 8)
```
